workouts.title: Week overview
workouts.description:
This week is our second week of the new fitness phase. We will switch the daily focus to gymnastics on Day 1 & 3 with weightlifting on day 2. The main goal of the week is to get into the rhythm of the phase and move really well.
Have fun!
